resources.string: Choose a matching camera profile first
Camera profiles describe the body. Lens profiles contain optical calibration and can have a different name, such as fixed lens.
Stored lens setting: %1$s. It has not been verified for this camera.
No compatible profiles are listed. Check the camera selection or use manual vignetting.
Manual vignette mode. Increase strength to apply it; no lens profile is required.
The Lensfun profile database is missing from this runtime. Manual vignetting is still available.
No matching lens profile. Select the correct camera and lens profile, or use manual vignetting.
The camera name in the photo is not a matched Lensfun camera profile. Compatible lens selection requires a matching camera profile.
The stored lens setting is unverified for this camera and may still affect the preview. Use image lens defaults to reset it.
Complete the shooting settings required by this lens profile.
The image data or selected profile provides no effective calibration at these settings.
Warp strength adjusts this image’s embedded chromatic aberration correction. Its metadata does not provide geometric distortion correction.
Lens calibration uses the original focal length, aperture, focus distance and crop factor. Fill missing image values before expecting profile corrections.
This works independently of a lens profile. Increase strength to use radius and steepness.
